title: Rank vs. Genus
exact_target: Compare the least number of fundamental-group generators with the least Heegaard genus, asking whether strict inequality and unbounded gaps occur in hyperbolic three-manifolds. Li proves both for closed orientable examples. \href{https://arxiv.org/abs/1106.6302v2}{[S3]}

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 3409 (OPG-1783). CC BY 4.0.
